tokens.name: background
tokens.usage: Page ground behind every section (body background). Warm paper in light, deep blue-slate in dark.

tokens.name: foreground
tokens.usage: Default text and headings on `background`, `surface`, `card`. 15.6:1 on background in both themes.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Alternate section band one step off `background`.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Highest non-card plane: sticky bars, inset panels over `surface`.

tokens.name: card
tokens.usage: Card and dropdown fill (`Card`, nav menu), always with a 1px `border`.

tokens.name: card-foreground
tokens.usage: Text inside `card`.

tokens.name: popover
tokens.usage: Floating menu and popover fill; same value as `card`.

tokens.name: popover-foreground
tokens.usage: Text inside `popover`.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: The one brand hue: primary Button fill, links, eyebrows, active nav, the " SYSTEMS" half of the wordmark. As text on `background` in LIGHT it measures 3.6:1 — the source pairs it with 9–10px mono eyebrows; keep eyebrows short and uppercase, never body copy. 7.7:1 in dark.

tokens.name: primary-foreground
tokens.usage: Label text on a `primary` fill. Source pair measures 3.9:1 in light (passes only for large/bold text), 8.2:1 in dark; kept exact, flagged.

tokens.name: secondary
tokens.usage: Secondary Button fill and secondary Badge fill.

tokens.name: secondary-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on `secondary` (13:1).

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Quiet fills: paused status badge, skeletons, disabled wells.

tokens.name: muted-foreground
tokens.usage: Supporting copy, captions, descriptors and ghost Button text on `background`/`card`: 5.0:1 light, 7.2:1 dark.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Hover fill for secondary, ghost and outline Buttons and menu items.

tokens.name: accent-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on `accent`.

tokens.name: destructive
tokens.usage: Destructive actions and error states only.

tokens.name: destructive-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on `destructive`. Source pair measures 4.0:1 light / 3.1:1 dark — kept exact, flagged: use bold 14px+ labels.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Every hairline: cards, inputs, dividers, the header rule (`* { border-color }`). Decorative (1.3–1.5:1), so never the only cue for a control's edge on its own.

tokens.name: input
tokens.usage: Input and textarea field tone (declared; the shipped fields draw with `border`).

tokens.name: ring
tokens.usage: Focus outline: `:focus-visible` is a 2px solid `ring` offset 3px; also the ring on Buttons.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Positive signal (confirmations, check icons). Always paired with a word or icon.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Caution signal. Pair with a word or icon.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Neutral informational signal.

tokens.name: status-live-fg
tokens.usage: Text of the “Live system” project-status badge on `card` (Tailwind emerald-700/800 light, emerald-400 dark).

tokens.name: status-live-border
tokens.usage: “Live system” badge border, applied at 30% (light) / 25% (dark) opacity.

tokens.name: status-live-fill
tokens.usage: “Live system” badge fill, applied at 10% opacity.

tokens.name: status-dev-fg
tokens.usage: Text of the “In development” project-status badge on `card` (Tailwind amber-700/800 light, amber-400 dark).

tokens.name: status-dev-border
tokens.usage: “In development” badge border, applied at 30% (light) / 25% (dark) opacity.

tokens.name: status-dev-fill
tokens.usage: “In development” badge fill, applied at 10% opacity.

tokens.name: status-concept-fg
tokens.usage: Text of the “Concept prototype” project-status badge on `card` (Tailwind violet-700/800 light, violet-400 dark).

tokens.name: status-concept-border
tokens.usage: “Concept prototype” badge border, applied at 30% (light) / 25% (dark) opacity.

tokens.name: status-concept-fill
tokens.usage: “Concept prototype” badge fill, applied at 10% opacity.

tokens.name: status-previous-fg
tokens.usage: Text of the “Previously used” project-status badge on `card` (Tailwind cyan-700/800 light, cyan-400 dark).

tokens.name: status-previous-border
tokens.usage: “Previously used” badge border, applied at 30% (light) / 25% (dark) opacity.

tokens.name: status-previous-fill
tokens.usage: “Previously used” badge fill, applied at 10% opacity.

tokens.name: mark-sky
tokens.usage: The sky-blue arm and hub of the Y mark. Logo only; the UI's blue is `primary`.

tokens.name: mark-ink
tokens.usage: The dark arms of the Y mark (light-ground versions) and the tile of the dark logo.

tokens.name: mark-tile
tokens.usage: The rounded tile behind the light logo; the light arms on dark grounds.

tokens.name: mark-hub
tokens.usage: The hub ring at the centre of the mark.

tokens.name: mark-stroke
tokens.usage: Hairline tick on the upper-left arm of the transparent marks.

tokens.name: collateral-ground
tokens.usage: Business-card background (print collateral).

tokens.name: collateral-cyan
tokens.usage: Print accent: “.SYSTEMS” suffix, bullets, crosshairs on the business cards. 9.8:1 on `collateral-ground`.

tokens.name: collateral-rule
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers and corner crosshairs on the cards.

tokens.name: collateral-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on the cards (titles, contact line); 6.3:1 on `collateral-ground`.

styles.name: display
styles.sample: Your business. Your workflow. Your software.
styles.usage: Home and landing hero h1 at sm+ (`text-7xl leading-[.95] tracking-[-0.055em]`); 48px below 640px. One per page, max-width 56rem.

styles.name: page-title
styles.usage: Interior page h1 at sm+ (`text-6xl leading-[1.05] tracking-[-0.04em]`); 36px below 640px.

styles.name: section-title
styles.usage: Section h2 at sm+ (`text-5xl tracking-tight`), always under an `eyebrow`; 30px/36px below 640px.

styles.name: section-title-sm
styles.usage: Mobile section h2 and secondary h2s (`text-3xl tracking-tight`).

styles.name: card-title
styles.sample: Clear control over your system and data
styles.usage: Card and pillar h3 (`text-xl font-semibold tracking-tight`).

styles.name: case-title
styles.usage: Case-study card title; turns `primary` on hover.

styles.name: lead
styles.sample: Software suited to your actual operation, clear control over your system and data.
styles.usage: Intro paragraph under h1/h2 in `muted-foreground` (`text-base leading-7 sm:text-lg`).

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Quote-to-job conversion, shopfloor travelers and inspection checklists.
styles.usage: Default copy in cards and sections (`text-sm leading-6`), usually `muted-foreground`.

styles.name: small
styles.sample: Keep drawing revisions and signoffs connected.
styles.usage: Secondary card detail and footnotes (`text-xs leading-5`).

styles.name: wordmark
styles.usage: The text wordmark in the header: `YORKSTEAD` in `foreground` + ` SYSTEMS` in `primary`; 12px below 640px.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: UPPERCASE section kicker in `primary` directly above every section h2.

styles.name: micro
styles.usage: UPPERCASE card kickers, index numbers (`01`), pill labels and menu group labels. The site's most-used mono size.

styles.name: descriptor
styles.usage: UPPERCASE descriptor beside the wordmark at xl, `muted-foreground`, after a `border` rule.

spacing.note: Tailwind's 4px scale; these are the steps the site actually uses.

tokens.name: space-0.5
tokens.usage: Badge vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-text nudges, pill vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-1.5
tokens.usage: Pill vertical padding, header action gap.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Button icon gap, badge horizontal padding, menu padding.

tokens.name: space-2.5
tokens.usage: Brand logo-to-wordmark gap, textarea vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Input/pill horizontal padding, eyebrow-to-heading gap (`mt-3`), mobile page gutter.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Default Button horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding (`CardContent p-5`).

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Page gutter at sm, hero pill margin, lead top margin.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Page gutter at lg; gap before item titles.

radius.note: All derive from `--radius: 0.7rem` in globals.css (sm ×0.75, md ×0.875, lg ×1, xl ×1.5). 2xl is Tailwind's untouched default and is SMALLER than xl.

tokens.name: radius
tokens.usage: The base the scale is computed from.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Small chips and inner tags.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, small index tags.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Inputs, textareas, icon buttons, header actions — the site's most-used corner.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Cards and dropdown menus.

tokens.name: radius-2xl
tokens.usage: Large media frames (Tailwind default, not re-based).

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Badges, status pills and eyebrow pills.

shadow.note: The site is border-first; shadows are rare.

tokens.name: shadow-glow
tokens.usage: The primary Button's halo in `primary` — the only branded shadow.

tokens.name: shadow-menu
tokens.usage: Floating dropdown menus (`shadow-2xl`).

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: Occasional lift on media thumbnails.

tokens.name: control-sm
tokens.usage: Small Button height (`h-8`).

tokens.name: control
tokens.usage: Default Button, icon Button and header action height (`h-9`).

tokens.name: control-lg
tokens.usage: Input height (`h-11`) — the touch-friendly field.

tokens.name: header
tokens.usage: Sticky header height; 64px from lg.

tokens.name: content-max
tokens.usage: Page container max width (`max-w-7xl`).

tokens.name: measure
tokens.usage: Hero and h1 max width (`max-w-4xl`).
